items.resolution: Section-12 scalar producers, Tables 35-36 and Annex K provenance are rebaselined from Amendments 1-5 wording to the locked current source with Changes 1-6 through 09.12.2024.

12.1.3 is excluded from 10.01.2025 by Change No. 6. The backward-compatible public function name is retained, but n<1e5 no longer executes a fabricated current-SP16 low-cycle method and instead returns an explicit fail-closed external-method boundary.
fatigue_guided selects ordinary fatigue 12.1.2, crane runway 12.2, or the n<1e5 external low-cycle boundary; incompatible routes are not evaluated in parallel.
Groups 1-2 use the printed Run strength bins through 675 N/mm2 and groups 3-8 use the printed all-steel constants. No interpolation or extrapolation is invented.

rho=sigma_min/sigma_max retains the normative sign and the tension/compression piecewise Table-36 expressions are selected explicitly; zero governing stress is rejected rather than assigning a synthetic rho.
The 12.2 alpha=0.77 route for 8K and metallurgical 7K cranes and alpha=1.1 otherwise is kept distinct from equations (171)-(172).

Equation (173) is available only for the declared built-up crane-runway beam route, with welded/friction Rv values selected explicitly and confirmation that stress components were obtained according to equation (67).
No dedicated NormCAD Section-12 end-to-end fatigue oracle was found in the retained library/corpus; no synthetic golden case was created.
